title: Hands-only CPR basics
summary: Call emergency services first; push hard and fast in the center of the chest.

key_points: push hard and fast in the center of the chest

sections.heading: Key points
sections.body: Hands-only CPR basics. Call emergency services first; push hard and fast in the center of the chest.

sections.heading: Procedure
sections.body: Call: phone emergency services and put it on speaker. Position: place the heel of your hand on the center of the chest. Compress: push hard and fast, about 2 inches deep at 100–120 per minute. Continue: do not stop until help arrives or an AED is ready. Get certified: take a hands-on CPR course for full training.

title: Classes of fire
summary: Class A: ordinary combustibles; B: flammable liquids; C: energized electrical; D: combustible metals; K: cooking oils.

sections.heading: Key points
sections.body: Classes of fire. Class A: ordinary combustibles; B: flammable liquids; C: energized electrical; D: combustible metals; K: cooking oils.

sections.heading: Procedure
sections.body: Identify the fuel: wood, paper, and cloth are Class A; gasoline and grease are Class B; live electrical equipment is Class C. sections.heading: Procedure
